content: We have carbon NMR data with chemical shifts. Need count of methyl groups in the molecule. Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In data we have peaks at 37.50, 36.39, 26.41. Those are likely aliphatic carbons. Methyl groups typically ~10-20 ppm, but can be up to 30. 26.41 could be a methylene or methyl attached to aromatic? 36-37 likely benzylic CH2. Need to infer structure? Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
